name: I, Miku
source:
It is a bright and sunny day in a typical Japanese high school, Tipakaru High, when a mysterious transfer student tentatively introduces herself. ZOMG, is that… the famous idol singer, Appuru Miku?? The one whose warm green eyes and hair captivate the world! In the flesh!

But… who is she really? Is she a genki girl? Tsundere? Is she smart? Baka? Weak? Strong? Is she the magical girl that will save the world? The servant who will win the grail? The slider the Haruhi fans have been waiting for?? A piece of software??? (Aw, c’mon, this is just getting ridiculous!)

Is she… all of those things?

Or nothing at all?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25948]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
在日本一所普通的高中Tipakaru高中，阳光明媚的一天里，一名神秘转学生忐忑地做了自我介绍。ZOMG，难道她就是那位著名偶像歌手苹果未来？！那个以温暖的绿色双眸与秀发迷倒全世界的人！她竟然真的就在眼前！

但……她究竟是谁？她是元气少女？傲娇？聪明？笨蛋？柔弱？强大？她是将拯救世界的魔法少女？将赢得圣杯的从者？还是凉宫春日粉丝一直等待的滑块？？一款软件？？？（哎，拜托，这越来越离谱了！）

她……难道拥有这一切？

还是说，她什么都不是？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25948]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
